<function name="GetNavAreaByID" parent="navmesh" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns a <page>CNavArea</page> by the given ID.

<note>Avoid calling this function every frame, as internally it does a lookup trough all the <page>CNavArea</page>s, call this once and store the result</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="id" type="number">ID of the <page>CNavArea</page> to get. Starts with 1.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="CNavArea">The <page>CNavArea</page> with given ID.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
